sections.title: Habitats
lines: The Long Hall pool

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A giant crocodile that waits below the surface.

sections.title: Attacks mechanics
lines: Bite and tail smash · The bite deals 3–18 damage. The tail smash deals 2–20. It can still attack with its tail in a 180-degree arc behind it while holding prey.
Surprise · The crocodile surprises on 1–3 on a d6.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Buoyant pool ambush · It waits at either side of the buoyant pool for creatures avoiding the group in the center. In this encounter, only stabbing weapons affect it, and attacks against it take a −2 penalty because of the water.

Drag underwater · The crocodile tries to take a bitten creature to the bottom. Drowning takes 2–4 rounds. The hold ends only after the crocodile takes at least 10 damage in total from hits. It then attacks another victim.

lines: Gary Gygax, Dungeonland (TSR, 1983), The Long Hall, changed view, p. 5.

sections.title: Habitats
lines: Meadow at the forest edge

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A furry dog nearly as large as an elephant.

sections.title: Attacks mechanics
lines: Grasping jaws · If harmed, the dog attacks. On an attack roll of 20 it grabs its target in its jaws and runs at twice its speed toward its place behind Area C. The held target takes an additional 2–12 damage per round. Once out of the party’s sight, the dog sits down and eats the captured creature.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Playful approach · The dog approaches out of curiosity. While it sniffs and snaps playfully, it has a 1-in-20 chance to knock someone down for 1–6 damage.

Rations or fetch · One week of ordinary rations or two weeks of iron rations gets it to rest and ignore the party. It plays with a thrown stick, staff, or pole for a turn and then goes to sleep near the forest edge.
Ticks in the fur · Searching its fur reveals three Giant Ticks.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: The printed dog movement uses a single prime, 18′.
Gary Gygax, Dungeonland (TSR, 1983), The Wilds of Dungeonland, A. Meadow, p. 13.

lines: A giant tick found in the fur of the meadow’s Giant Dog.

sections.title: Special attacks mechanics
lines: Attachment and blood drain · A hit attaches the tick to its target. The tick drains 1–6 points thereafter. A bitten character has a 50% chance of contracting a disease.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Three ticks on the Giant Dog · A search of the dog’s fur turns up three ticks with 19, 18, and 17 HP respectively.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: The encounter gives no separate interval for the blood drain.
Gary Gygax, Dungeonland (TSR, 1983), The Wilds of Dungeonland, A. Meadow, p. 13.
